verdict.rationale: Brevo can be driven without its UI through its own API: API-key and machine-to-machine OAuth for server-to-server use, official SDKs, idempotency keys, and a sandbox mode for testing sends without delivering them. All of these suit unattended automation. However, nothing documents a CLI or CI-specific usage, and the IP-whitelisting flow relies on a one-click email authorization, which can get in the way of ephemeral CI runners. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs or examples, guidance for non-interactive auth from dynamic CI IPs, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Authenticate with an API key, or with OAuth 2.0 — including machine-to-machine (M2M) for server-to-server integrations.
Official SDKs with full API coverage. Available for Node.js, Python, and PHP.
Test transactional emails without sending them using sandbox mode
Prevent duplicate emails by using idempotency keys in batch transactional email requests
